svg.title: OpenDeepMind — Start with a clear question. / Make conclusions testable.
svg.desc: OpenDeepMind / Start with a clear question. / Make conclusions testable. / Φ8: definitions, boundaries and evidence / P9: models, constraints and falsifiers / T10: explicitly activated engineering invention / Independent project; evals is an observation layer, not a model or simulation service / Claim ledger: complete references without circular support; G = (N, E), cycle(G) = false; N denotes claim/inference nodes and E references; validity does not establish truth / Confidence field: finite values and explicit bounds; 0 ≤ cᵢ ≤ 1; Booleans and nonfinite values are rejected; probability requires calibration / SYNTHETIC CONCEPT / AI ARTWORK / NOT MEASURED DATA
